This doc will be covering Kurama over the course of the dark tournament

Kuramas assult towards a demon named Roto is stopped by a threat towards his parents life placing him into a trap where he cannot fight back due to the threat towards his loved ones. He counters this by throwing a pebble as a distraction in order to get the time to plant a deadily seed into his body that will instantly kill him from the inside. Keep in mind he came up with this on the spot

As Kurama is watching a match he senses that three of the fighters were humans deducing that they were in fact not there by their own choice. He likely deduced this based on the theme in the dark tournament that there is only supposed to be one team comprised of humans. That fact would lead to the deduction that there cannot be a human in another team which means that the humans he saw have to have some kinda quirk that seperates them from humans since the dark tournament accepted them. Since he sensed they were indeed fully human he could likely deduce that the most probable reason would be that they weren’t sentient or didn’t wanna be there

Hiei and Kurama are fighting a robot. Hiei realizing his sword is having no effect decides to try to use the darkness flame which would lead to both of his arms being unusuable. To prevent this he quickly uses the robots non sentient mind against it by moving it to its other arm which the robot follows due to its programming. He moves towards the direction of the other robotic arm to make them crash disabling its grip on Hiei preventing his needed usage of the darkness flame

This action leads to the robot being able to trap him instead with both of its arms. Before the arms can even reach him Kurama manages to use the robotic nature of it against it again by distributing its system with his rose whip knowing that robots don’t feel pain therefore they wont be afraid to avoid it
Managed to heal the illness of a diying man with the use of botanical poisons despite never having worked in any human healthcare

Kurama goes up against an opponent named Gamma who uses makeup as his main ability which he is able to use to trap Kurama with 280kgs worth of force divided into his legs and arms. Kurama unable to move fully is seen as an easy opponent for Gamma which leads him to attack him recklessly without defense which Kurama counters by using a rose whip from his hair to kill him off. He likely made himself seem weaker on purpose (since he can move better against Toya) and used his ”weakness” to get Gamma to attack him without any defense in mind so that he could kill him easier

Right before he dies Gamma places a curse on Kurama that disables his aura along with the 280kgs of weight. Even after that he’s shown to be able to evade attacks from Toya who should be equal if not superior to Gamma who was relatively matched with Kurama

As Toya is about to finish off Kurama with a final blow through his head which Kurama counters by using his wounds created by Toya likely intentionally (not that he could have avoided the attacks better it was just a part of the strategy) to take Toya out right before he falls unconscious mere moments later by using the energy within his body to use his rose powers. He likely predicted that Toya would try to strike him down up close based on the way he spoke about Gamma and avenging him which likely made Kurama aware that Toya took this battle personally and would therefore try to kill him upclose

Kurama watches the match between the Toguro brothers and the high five rangers, as he watches Karasu he deduces that his power likely works by inserting his aura into the opponents body before making it explode by observing that the locations of his hands directly correlated with where the explosion landed

Kuwabara mentions to Kurama that Yusuke was acting weird and raced off that morning while Genkai never came back. Kurama then concludes that one of them must be dead since Karasu told him earlier that day that someone would die and the change in dynamic would be a sign of a death (it’s unknown if he managed to deduce that it was Genkai)

Kurama used the poision that allows him to turn into his fox form as practice before the match. From the usage he was able to deduce that it lasts for 15 minutes and that it takes awhile before the form activates which is why he took a sip just two minutes before the match

As the match starts he decides to bluff by implying that he would use a move to defeat him. By using this bluff he tries to get an advantage by using a technique that covers a wide area between them to make Karasu keep his distance. This was also likely to be a strategy to get enough time to transform into Yoko

It’s gets revealed that Kurama was wrong about Karasus ability is to create explosions from any position which he uses to blast of a chunk of Kuramas arm, despite this Kurama is still able to think clearly

Karasu traps Kurama into an area of his explosives which Kurama calmly counters by using something known as the humble plant to protect himself since it naturally closes its leaves when touched by fire which perfectly counters Karasus ability since it has fire elements
Kurama is knocked out of his fox form despite having 10 minutes left based on the data. He deduces that it’s could be that he has built a resistance towards it by using it to much

Kurama goes into hand to hand combat with Karasu to damage him right at his heart to create an opening, despite not being able to summon plants from the demon world anymore he had the yoko spirit within him which allowed him to summon it from a wound by using his life energy. He likely wanted to get injured to summon the plants
